task: Implement the desktop/Tauri side of Phase 12 on branch feat/phase-12-android-companion. HEAD includes 8baaf67, which fixes synchronized persistent in-memory Session state across TCP reconnects and concurrent replay tests; preserve it. Start must require explicit ownerConfirmed=true, reject temporary chat/safe mode/invalid agent-owner, default bind 127.0.0.1, permit RFC1918 only with explicit private-network confirmation, reject wildcard/public, use bounded ephemeral port, generate/consume a one-time pairing key only in memory, return raw pairing code only in the Owner/UI start result, and never log/persist it. Add a real Rust integration test using temporary Database and localhost TCP client that authenticates, performs pair/session/history or queue, rejects wrong MAC/replay/temporary chat/revocation, and proves stop closes the port. Run cargo fmt/check/clippy/focused/full tests, relevant contracts/desktop tests, diff check, and leave a clean worktree. Commit all desktop changes exactly as `feat: integrate phase 12 companion transport desktop`. No Android/docs/Phase13/publish/remote/native subagents/direct edits.
